name: Chapman Social Science Summer Pre-College Research Experience
what_you_do: Do real social science research with professors and Chapman student mentors. You study data from a national survey about fears. You make a poster and share your findings.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 10 to 12 in the fall after the program. Students who just finished high school can join too. A 3.5 GPA or higher is suggested.
pay_detail: The 2027 cost is not posted yet. You also buy an SPSS grad pack for about $34.95 and bring your own laptop.
duration: Weekdays 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.
deadline_text: Registration for Summer 2027 opens in spring 2027. You can join the priority list now.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer 2027 priority list form on the program page. You will be told when registration opens. Questions go to program director Dr. Ann Gordon.
notes: 2026 was the first year of this program. You get a certificate of completion.
